Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.zh: 由传说中的光剑妖精主讲的基础教学课程，欢迎收看！
Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.en: A lecture from Lightsaber Fairy on the fundamentals of danmaku dodging.

Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.zh: 本关中所有子弹显示判定范围，就算弹幕高手在游戏前也要先摸清判定哦～
Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.en: Hitboxes are shown on all bullets during the lesson. Good to know even if you are a danmaku expert.

Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.zh: 随机弹的花样很多的哦～
Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.en: Randomized shots come in many varieties and shapes.

Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.zh: 包括绝对固定和相对固定
Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.en: Absolute fixed shots and relative fixed shots.

Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.zh: 对自机狙的理解是沙包成长的第一步！
Shooting.MenuCameraCtrl::SetCameraTarget.en: Understanding aimed shots is the first step towards becoming a better player.
